payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details on how the proposed training framework mitigates bias patterns in NLI datasets through debiasing techniques and improved generalization ability.

claims.text: The proposed training framework mitigates the bias pattern by reducing the misleading effects of annotation artifacts and enhancing models' semantic learning ability.
The framework allows for balancing artifacts across labels by assigning specific weights to samples, creating an artifact-balanced distribution during training.
Experimental results demonstrate that the framework effectively improves models' generalization ability in cross-dataset testing.
